combat_tables.description: Attack resolution tables for determining combat outcomes. Roll one six-sided die (1-6) and cross-reference with the odds ratio.

outcome_codes.D: Disrupted - Target cannot move or attack next turn
outcome_codes.W: WIA - Wounded in Action - Unit wounded with reduced effectiveness
outcome_codes.K: KIA - Killed in Action - Unit eliminated from play
outcome_codes.H: HVY - Heavy Damage - Unit heavily damaged

terran_attack_table.description: Used when Terran units attack Arachnid or Humanoid units. Also used when Humanoid units attack Arachnid units.

alien_attack_table.description: Used when Arachnid units attack Terran units. Note: Humanoid units use the Terran Attack Table when defending against Arachnids.

disrupted_status.description: When a unit is disrupted, place a disrupted marker on the unit.
effects: Unit may not move during the next player segment
Unit may not re-enter tunnel systems
Unit may not engage in any type of attack during the next player segment
disrupted_status.removal: Remove disrupted marker at the end of the next player segment

combat_resolution_example.scenario: Terran units attack Arachnid units in a hex
steps: Attacking Terran units have combined attack strength of 12
Defending Arachnid units have combined defense strength of 8
Look up Terran Attack Table at 1:1, roll 5
Result: Disrupted - place disrupted marker on target unit

notes: Always round odds ratios DOWN to the nearest category
Heavy weapons affect all units in the target hex
Disrupted units are still counted for defense but cannot attack
KIA units are removed from the game immediately
WIA units have reduced effectiveness for the remainder of the game
